summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K furnishing a shareholder letter from Chairman/CEO Lewis Black, dated September 29, 2026, providing a corporate update. The letter reports first tungsten concentrate production at the Sangdong mine in South Korea, the first output in 33 years, with the mill running 13 hours daily and scaling to 24/7, plus roughly 4.6 months of stockpiled ore. Phase II underground development is underway, with Metso on site supporting Phase I ramp-up. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated; this is an operational update, not a special situation.
